Recipe 16 · Dinner

Thomas's Beefy Taco Pasta Skillet

Everything you love about tacos, tossed with pasta in one skillet. Taco Tuesday just got a promotion.

Jump to recipe ↓
Prep10 minutes
Cook20 minutes
Serves6 people
Nutritionabout 700 cal · 38g protein per serving

The pasta cooks right in the seasoned beef and broth, so there is only one pan to wash.

What you need

  • 1 pound ground beef (one store package)
  • 12 ounces penne pasta (one box)
  • 1 packet taco seasoning (1 ounce)
  • 1 can diced tomatoes with green chiles, undrained (10 ounces)
  • 2 cups beef broth
  • 1 cup shredded Mexican-blend cheese
  • Sour cream and sliced green onions, for serving

Also grab: a big deep skillet with a lid, a wooden spoon and a measuring cup.

How to make it

  1. Brown the beef. Cook it in a big deep skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, about 5–6 minutes. Drain the grease.
  2. Add the seasoning. Stir in the taco seasoning until the beef is coated.
  3. Add the pasta and liquid. Stir in the uncooked pasta, tomatoes with their juice and beef broth.
  4. Simmer until tender. Bring it to a boil, then turn the heat to low, cover and simmer for 12–15 minutes. Stir once or twice so nothing sticks.
  5. Melt the cheese. Sprinkle it over the top, cover for 2 minutes and let it melt.
  6. Serve it up with sour cream and green onions.
